summary: Frontend re-test for Iteration 2 (new Showcase section). All 13 acceptance criteria pass: showcase-section, showcase-mosaic and 4 columns render (col-4 visible only on desktop, hidden on mobile as designed), nav-link-showcase scrolls into view, mobile-nav-link-showcase exists in mobile menu panel, showcase-cta links to #contact. All previously-working data-testids still present (site-navigation, theme-toggle-button, download-resume-button, hero-section, work-section, all 7 work-item-* entries, values-section, testimonials-section, accolades-press-section, contact-section, mobile-menu-toggle). Theme toggle still flips html.dark class. /resume.pdf returns 200 OK with content-type application/pdf. 0 page errors and 0 console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Showcase.jsx: marquee uses two duplicated arrays (loop = [...items, ...items]) — fine for seamless looping. No issues.
Column duration values (42/56/48/62s) provide pleasant variety; -my-[20%] + h-[140%] overflow trick combined with linear-gradient mask gives a clean fade — solid Billy-Sweeney-style execution.
Showcase content block uses lg:grid-cols-12 with a 7/5 split — nicely matches the rest of the site's typographic rhythm.
Two of the col4 image URLs are non-Unsplash hosts (one emergentagent CDN, one Unsplash) — both loaded successfully during the test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 Showcase section verified clean. Section order in App.js: Hero -> Showcase -> Work -> Values -> Testimonials -> AccoladesPress -> Contact. Navigation array now has 7 items: intro, showcase, work, values, references, press, contact. Showcase has 4 marquee columns; col-4 is wrapped in a `hidden md:block` div, so it is not visible on mobile (<768px) but its DOM element still exists. CTA href=#contact. Resume PDF still 200 OK (application/pdf). No console or page errors. Nothing previously working broke.
